level: ENGINE-LEVEL (scores persisted engine output or a transcript; NOT the attended delivery-level pass d1_ocr_acceptance_probe.py)

thresholds.note: measured against these listed words only; a run that misses any listed fact fails

fixtures.note: no engine output supplied for this fixture (an attended delivery pass is different evidence; a bounded partial run is scored not_evaluable)

note: a pass here scores what the engines ACTUALLY produced and claimed; a not_evaluable fixture means the scorer never saw a complete real engine run for it, and is never counted as acceptance. Primary OCR acceptance additionally requires output from a real PaddleOCR run.
